title: Alain our guide was great
text:

author: Rosethered

title: An absolutely exceptional tour of the Alhambra with an exceptional guide!
text:
We were lucky to be accompanied for 3 hours and 30 minutes by Andy, a fascinating, extremely kind, and captivating guide. Thanks to his explanations, his anecdotes, and his incredible knowledge of the place, we didn't just visit the Alhambra: we truly dove into its history and traveled back in time.

The 3.5 hours flew by because the tour was so lively and interesting. He knew how to captivate adults and children alike (we have 3, including a little 5-year-old), answer all our questions, and help us discover details we would never have noticed on our own.
